memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he reaffirmed for them decrees and laws. And Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak near the holy place of the Lord. "See!" he said to all the people. "This stone will be a witness against us. It has heard all the words the Lord has said to us. It will be a witness against you if you are untrue to your God." — Josh 24:25-27 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joshua seals the day with a covenant and sets up a large stone as a witness. It is a striking image — a silent stone standing under the oak, a permanent reminder of the promises made that day. "This stone has heard all the words," Joshua says. It would stand as a lasting testimony to the commitment the people made before God.

People forget. Feelings fade. So God's people have often set up reminders — stones, altars, feasts, written words — to hold them to what they know is true. Joshua even "recorded these things in the Book of the Law," so the covenant would not be lost to memory. He knew that faithful commitments need help to endure.

We need reminders too. Our hearts are prone to wander, and yesterday's resolve grows dim. This is why we return to Scripture again and again, why we gather with God's people, why we keep the ordinances Christ gave us. These are our "stones," calling us back to what we have promised and to the God we serve.

Above all, the Lord's Supper is our standing witness, where we remember Christ's covenant sealed in His blood until He comes (1 Cor 11:25-26). What reminders have you set up to keep your heart faithful? Do not despise them. Let every stone, every page, every gathering call you back to the Lord.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What "reminders" help keep you faithful to God?
2. Why do our wandering hearts need such witnesses?
3. How does the Lord's Supper call you back to Christ's covenant?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, my heart forgets and wanders. Thank You for the reminders that call me back to You. Help me treasure Your word, Your people, and Christ's covenant of grace. Amen.
